$comment: Machine-readable extension of DESIGN.md, recorded from the built code. lib/tokens.ts is normative; where this file and the code disagree, the code wins.
name: juanpaulomariano.com

laws: Play once, then rest. Nothing loops uninvited; the hero orbit and its scroll cue are the only resident motion.
Transform and opacity only. Travel is translateX/scaleX, never left.
Arm one-shot moments on IntersectionObserver visibility (thresholds 0.35-0.5).
Every animation ships a reduced-motion end state; states stay reachable, only motion is withheld.
Two effects never fight over one transform: each drives a registered custom property and the element composes them.

stageRing.note: a call just arrived; a loop would nag

liveDot.condition: only while user-started audio is playing

focus.onDark: outline color #FFFFFF, scoped to #work in app/globals.css

breakpoints.note: Showcase sections split two-column at xl, not lg: measured, 1024 leaves ~32ch text columns; 1280 holds at ~48ch.

stage-reserve.note: measured at each range's narrowest width; lives in globals.css because Tailwind cannot see interpolated classes

darkSection.rule: exactly one dark section ground on the site

stagePanel.rule: a panel inside a white section, never a section ground; blue-black so it never reads as the same material as darkSection

meanings.selected-works-rail: active marker and the words 'In progress'
meanings.living-pipeline: the lead's current position only; traversed rail stays ink
meanings.transcript-rail: the agent is speaking right now

pill.scope: conversion controls only: nav Book a call, hero CTA pair, final CTA pair, lightbox floating overlay buttons

circle.scope: diagram dots only: pipeline nodes 11px, travelling lead 7px, live dot 6px, browser chrome dots 9px

icons.detail: No icon fonts, no Lucide/Heroicons, no decorative SVG. Play is a CSS border triangle, pause is two 3px bars, arrows are the characters -> and <-. Real brand logos in /public/logos/ and the hero orbit geometry are the only SVG.
icons.detectorNote: detect.mjs flags the border-triangle play glyphs as 'side-tab accent border' (borderLeft 9px/12px solid). False positive: they render as triangles, not stripes.

laws: An uncaptioned screenshot is texture, not evidence.
Transcript prose is verbatim, including false starts; do not tighten it.
Masked values match verbatim between transcript and screenshot (redaction contract).
Ticker events are real CRM writes at their transcribed moments.
Empty src renders a stated pending placeholder; captions are written only once the image exists.
Evidence order is outcome, then provenance, then machinery.
Arrays gate chrome: switches and nav dots render only at length > 1.
No invented metrics; numbers live inside sentences.

display.name: Space Grotesk
display.scope: section titles, subsection titles, rail index items, the call stage caller name

body.name: Manrope
body.scope: everything else, including the hero headline at weight 800

loadedUnused.name: Instrument Serif
loadedUnused.note: a switchable hero alternate (HEADLINE_FONT in components/hero.tsx); ships nowhere
